preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) >= 2])
preconditions.description: Each test case has N businesses where N is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for N, edges in [(int(stdin.readline()), [tuple(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(N - 1)]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N-1 roads connecting N businesses.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N for a, b in edges) for N, edges in [(int(stdin.readline()), [tuple(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(N - 1)]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each road connects two businesses numbered between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= A_i <= 10**9 for A_i in map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: Each business value A_i is a positive integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N for N, A in [(int(stdin.readline()), list(map(int, stdin.readline().split()))) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N business values.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum possible damage across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: max_damage == max(sum(math.gcd(*[A[i-1] for i in component])) for component in connected_components) for v in range(1, N+1) for connected_components in [find_connected_components(N, edges, v, A)])
postconditions.description: The maximum damage is computed by evaluating the sum of GCDs of values in each connected component after removing business v and its incident edges, for each possible v, and selecting the maximum.
